Trust in the LORD , and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, [Name], and verily thou shalt be fed.
Commit thy way unto the LORD, [Name] ; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
He shall cover thee with his feathers, [Name], and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
He will not suffer thy foot to be moved, [Name]: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge, [Name].
Commit thy works unto the LORD, [Name] , and thy thoughts shall be established.
Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end, [Name].
Cease, my son, [Name], to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty, [Name]; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
Prepare thy work without, [Name], and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, [Name]; and thy want as an armed man.
Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself, [Name]; and discover not a secret to another:
Hast thou found honey, [Name]? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house, [Name]; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, [Name], and the LORD shall reward thee.
Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit, [Name]? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words, [Name]? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, [Name], and chains about thy neck.
My son, [Name], if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
My son, [Name], walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
Then shalt thou understand righteousness, [Name], and judgment, and equity; yea , every good path.
When wisdom entereth into thine heart, [Name], and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
Discretion shall preserve thee, [Name], understanding shall keep thee:
To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, [Name] , from the man that speaketh froward things;
That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, [Name] , and keep the paths of the righteous.
My son, [Name], forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee, [Name].
Let not mercy and truth forsake thee, [Name]: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man, [Name].
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart, [Name]; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, [Name], and he shall direct thy paths.
Be not wise in thine own eyes, [Name]: fear the LORD , and depart from evil.
It shall be health to thy navel, [Name], and marrow to thy bones.
Honour the LORD with thy substance, [Name], and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, [Name], and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
My son, [Name], despise not the chastening of the LORD ; neither be weary of his correction:
She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her, [Name].
My son, [Name], let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
So shall they be life unto thy soul, [Name], and grace to thy neck.
Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, [Name], and thy foot shall not stumble.
When thou liest down, [Name], thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
For the LORD shall be thy confidence, [Name], and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it, [Name] .
Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm, [Name].
Envy thou not the oppressor, [Name], and choose none of his ways.
Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee, [Name]: love her, and she shall keep thee.
Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding, [Name].
Exalt her, and she shall promote thee, [Name]: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace, [Name]: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
Hear, O my son, [Name], and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
I have taught thee in the way of wisdom, [Name]; I have led thee in right paths.
When thou goest, [Name], thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life, [Name].
My son, [Name], attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
Let them not depart from thine eyes, [Name]; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
Keep thy heart with all diligence, [Name]; for out of it are the issues of life.
Put away from thee a froward mouth, [Name], and perverse lips put far from thee.
Let thine eyes look right on, [Name], and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
Ponder the path of thy feet, [Name], and let all thy ways be established.
My son, [Name], attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
My son, [Name], if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, [Name], thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
Do this now, my son, [Name], and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
Give not sleep to thine eyes, [Name], nor slumber to thine eyelids.
Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, [Name] , and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, [Name], and thy want as an armed man.
My son, [Name], keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee, [Name]: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
For by me thy days shall be multiplied, [Name], and the years of thy life shall be increased.
If thou be wise, [Name], thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it .
Bow down thine ear, [Name], and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee, [Name]; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge, [Name],
That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, [Name]; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go, [Name]:
Be not thou one of them that strike hands, [Name], or of them that are sureties for debts.
If thou hast nothing to pay, [Name], why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set, [Name].
Seest thou a man diligent in his business, [Name]? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men .
When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, [Name], consider diligently what is before thee:
And put a knife to thy throat, [Name], if thou be a man given to appetite.
Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom, [Name].
Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not, [Name]? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, [Name], and lose thy sweet words.
Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words, [Name].
For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee, [Name].
Apply thine heart unto instruction, [Name], and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
My son, [Name], if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things, [Name].
Hear thou, my son, [Name], and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, [Name], and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, [Name], when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, [Name], or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war, [Name]: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
If thou faint in the day of adversity, [Name], thy strength is small.
My son, [Name], eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul, [Name]: when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, [Name], and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
My son, [Name], fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
Boast not thyself of to morrow, [Name]; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
Let another man praise thee, [Name], and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
Thine own friend, [Name], and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
My son, [Name], be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, [Name], and look well to thy herds.
The lambs are for thy clothing, [Name], and the goats are the price of the field.
And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, [Name], for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
{name}, the LORD who created and redeemed His people calls His own by name. In Christ you belong to Him — so take courage in His redeeming love and do not fear.
{name}, the same God who promised Israel His presence, strength and help is your God in Christ. You need not fear or be dismayed, for He upholds His own.
{name}, in Christ you are God's workmanship, created for the good works He prepared beforehand for you to walk in.
{name}, Jesus Christ is the resurrection and the life. Because you believe in Him, you have the hope of life that outlasts death.
{name}, may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him, that you may abound in hope through the power of the Holy Spirit.

{name}, receive the same affection the apostle John had for his friend Gaius: a heartfelt prayer that your life would go well and your body be strong, flourishing in step with a soul that is thriving in Christ.
{name}, receive the call of wisdom to honour the godly instruction you have been given, and let it shape the way you live.
{name}, hold fast to the fear of the LORD, for there is a sure future, and the hope of those who walk with Him will not be cut off.
{name}, do not forget the teaching of wisdom; let your heart keep its commands, for they are life and peace.
{name}, the good purposes God declared over the exiles reveal His heart; in Christ you too can trust Him with your future and your hope.
{name}, you can rest in this: God works all things together for good to those who love Him and are called according to His purpose.
{name}, in all these things you are more than a conqueror through Him who loved you.
{name}, you can trust the God who promised to supply His people's every need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
{name}, in Christ who strengthens you, you can face whatever He calls you to, in plenty and in want.
{name}, you can say with David: the LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
{name}, even in the darkest valley you need fear no evil, for the Shepherd is with you.
{name}, take the courage God gave Joshua: be strong, do not be afraid, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
{name}, as you wait on the LORD, He renews your strength; you can run and not be weary, walk and not faint.
{name}, hear the invitation of Jesus to come to Him when you are weary and burdened, and to receive His rest.
{name}, seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, and trust Him to provide what you need.
{name}, receive the peace Jesus gives His disciples — not as the world gives; let not your heart be troubled or afraid.
{name}, the love God showed the world He shows to you: He gave His only Son, that believing in Him you should not perish but have everlasting life.
{name}, if you are in Christ you are a new creation; the old has passed, the new has come.
{name}, cast all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.
{name}, God is your refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
{name}, the LORD's mercies never fail; His compassions are new every morning — great is His faithfulness.
{name}, His compassions are new every morning; great is His faithfulness toward you.
{name}, the LORD your God is in your midst, mighty to save; He delights over His people with joy.
{name}, be content, for God has said He will never leave you nor forsake you.
{name}, if you confess your sins, He is faithful and just to forgive you and to cleanse you from all unrighteousness.
{name}, the one whose mind is stayed on the LORD He keeps in perfect peace, because they trust in Him.
{name}, be strong and of good courage; the LORD your God goes with you — He will not fail you nor forsake you.
{name}, the LORD is near to the broken-hearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
{name}, God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
{name}, be assured that nothing in all creation can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus.
{name}, you have been crucified with Christ; the life you now live, you live by faith in the Son of God who loved you and gave Himself for you.
{name}, in Christ you are called to be light in the world; let your light so shine that others may glorify your Father.
{name}, no temptation has overtaken you but such as is common to all; God is faithful and will make a way of escape.
{name}, come boldly to the throne of grace, that you may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
{name}, the LORD will preserve you from all evil; He will keep your life.
{name}, the LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and He knows those who take refuge in Him.
{name}, the LORD holds your right hand and says to His own, Fear not; I will help you.
{name}, dwelling in the shelter of the Most High, you abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
{name}, in the world you will have trouble, but take heart — Jesus has overcome the world.
{name}, this is the heritage of the servants of the LORD: no weapon formed against them shall prosper — your vindication is from Him.
{name}, in Christ you belong to a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a people for God's own possession, called out of darkness into His light.
{name}, He is able to keep you from falling and to present you faultless before His glory with great joy.
{name}, the LORD is your light and your salvation; whom shall you fear?
{name}, be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and thanksgiving make your requests known to God.
{name}, may the peace of God, which passes all understanding, guard your heart and mind through Christ Jesus.
